title: Service Mesh Architecture, Envoy Proxy & Ambient Data Planes
summary: Master cloud-native service mesh architecture: sidecar proxy injection vs sidecarless ambient data planes (ztunnel / waypoint), Envoy xDS dynamic configuration APIs (CDS, LDS, EDS, RDS), distributed request tracing, and mesh traffic debugging.
learningObjectives: Compare sidecar vs sidecarless ambient service mesh architectures and evaluate memory/CPU tradeoffs.
Inspect and debug Envoy proxy xDS configuration states (CDS, LDS, EDS, RDS) using istioctl proxy-status.
Enforce namespace-wide automated sidecar injection labels and verify proxy container attachment.

curriculumModules.title: Data Plane Architectures: Sidecar Proxies vs Ambient Mesh
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: Traditional service meshes inject an Envoy sidecar proxy into every application Pod, consuming 50-100MB RAM per pod. Ambient mesh separates the data plane into node-shared L4 zero-trust tunnels (ztunnel) and opt-in per-service L7 waypoint proxies, eliminating sidecar lifecycle coupling and reducing cluster memory footprints.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Adopt sidecar injection on high-density sensitive namespaces requiring fine-grained L7 policies; utilize ambient mesh for high-scale, multi-tenant clusters to reduce compute costs and eliminate restart cycles on mesh upgrades.

curriculumModules.title: Envoy xDS Dynamic Configuration & Proxy Diagnostics
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: The control plane programs Envoy proxies via xDS gRPC streams: Cluster Discovery (CDS), Listener Discovery (LDS), Endpoint Discovery (EDS), and Route Discovery (RDS). Mismatches or sync delays trigger stale routing and 503 Service Unavailable errors.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Automate istioctl analyze in continuous delivery pipelines to detect route misconfigurations before deployment, and monitor Envoy cluster_manager.cds.version telemetry.

labs.title: Enforcing Automated Sidecar Injection and Validating xDS Sync
labs.scenario: Configure service mesh namespace governance: label namespace mesh-apps with istio-injection=enabled, deploy application Pod web-frontend in namespace mesh-apps, and run istioctl proxy-status to verify Envoy proxy synchronization.
labs.productionContext: Automated sidecar injection ensures all microservices within a tenant boundary inherit cryptographic mutual TLS and distributed observability without application code modification.
objectives: Create and label namespace mesh-apps with istio-injection=enabled.
Deploy Pod web-frontend in namespace mesh-apps.
Verify Envoy proxy synchronization via istioctl proxy-status.

troubleshootingGuide.problem: Namespace label missing or istioctl command not executed.
troubleshootingGuide.cause: Label was omitted or proxy-status check was not run.
troubleshootingGuide.solution: Execute kubectl label namespace mesh-apps istio-injection=enabled and istioctl proxy-status.

labs.title: Running Automated Mesh Configuration Audits with istioctl analyze
labs.scenario: Execute proactive configuration analysis on namespace production using istioctl analyze, save the audit log to /mesh/analyze-report.txt, and confirm zero syntax or reference errors exist in the mesh topology.
labs.productionContext: Running istioctl analyze catches orphaned VirtualServices, invalid DestinationRule subsets, and Gateway port mismatches before traffic disruption occurs in production.
objectives: Execute istioctl analyze on namespace production.

assessmentQuestions.question: What is the primary architectural advantage of Istio Ambient Mesh over traditional sidecar-based service meshes?
options: Ambient mesh compiles application binaries into WebAssembly modules.

Ambient mesh separates L4 transport zero-trust encryption (ztunnel on each node) from optional L7 application processing (waypoint proxies), reducing per-pod memory overhead from 50MB+ to zero and avoiding application pod restarts during mesh upgrades.
Ambient mesh replaces all Kubernetes services with DNS SRV records.
Ambient mesh bypasses Linux kernel packet routing entirely.
assessmentQuestions.explanation: Ambient mesh eliminates the sidecar proxy from application pods. Node-level ztunnels handle mTLS at Layer 4 with negligible memory overhead, while Layer 7 waypoint proxies scale independently per service.

assessmentQuestions.question: In Envoy proxy terminology, what do CDS and EDS represent in the dynamic xDS control plane protocol?
options: CDS is Container Delivery Service and EDS is Endpoint Delivery Service.
CDS is Cluster Discovery Service (discovering upstream service clusters) and EDS is Endpoint Discovery Service (discovering dynamic backend pod IP/port endpoints).
CDS is Certificate Distribution Service and EDS is Encryption Distribution Service.
CDS is ConfigMap Data Source and EDS is Etcd Data Source.
assessmentQuestions.explanation: CDS (Cluster Discovery Service) informs Envoy about upstream clusters (services), while EDS (Endpoint Discovery Service) dynamically streams the individual Pod IP endpoints backing those clusters without requiring configuration reload.
